measurement: uncompressed unique JavaScript and CSS bytes referenced by each route's generated Next.js client-reference manifest
headroom: 15 percent above the August 7, 2026 production-build baseline, rounded up to the next kibibyte; file counts allow two additional assets

fieldTargets.note: Release targets for a deployed browser run. They are not inferred from build asset bytes.
